publicSearchEnable: Allow public web search for this routine
publicSearchHelp: Enter up to 4 public queries, one per line, with at most 160 characters per query. Each run may send these exact queries to Exa, and the Bot can read public pages found by the searches. Use public information only.
publicSearchLimit: Enter 1 to 4 public queries, up to 160 characters each.
publicSearchControl: Use plain text on each query line.
publicSearchDuplicate: Each public query must be unique.
publicSearchTarget: The workspace owner can approve public queries for a local Bot’s direct chat.
publicSearchChanged: This routine changed. Reopen it and review its current settings before updating search permission.
publicSearchTransfer: Public search permission expires on transfer. Review and approve the receiving Bot’s exact queries separately.
webhookScheduleHelp: This routine has no time-based schedule. Save it, then create a Webhook key in its details. You can also run it manually.
webhookTarget: The workspace owner can configure Webhooks for a local Bot’s direct chat.
webhookInstructions: Send a POST with Authorization: Bearer <key>. The optional body must be a JSON object up to 8 KiB. Use Idempotency-Key to deduplicate retries for 24 hours.
webhookKeyOnce: This key is shown once. Copy it now and keep it somewhere secure. Anyone with it can trigger this routine.
webhookManualCopy: Select and copy the value manually.
webhookRotateHelp: The current key will stop accepting requests. Update any services that use this routine with the new key.
webhookRevokeHelp: The current key will stop accepting requests. The routine and its run history will remain available.
webhookChanged: The Webhook configuration changed. Check its current status before trying again.
webhookUnknown: The result could not be confirmed. Check the current status before changing the key again. A key from a lost response cannot be shown.
webhookReadFailed: Could not check the Webhook status. Try checking again.
